_comment: Maps the informal subject name in an EEG filename to the participant ID used by
the PsychoPy session. The recordings are named by nickname (ban, minhanh) while
sessions are keyed by student ID, and nothing in either file links them - which
is why pairing otherwise falls back to wall-clock containment.
A value may be a full ID or just a trailing fragment; a fragment matches any
participant whose ID ends with it. Recorded here rather than inferred, because a
wrong pairing mislabels every block in a figure.
ban = 111240033 is independently corroborated: the five blink cues logged in that
session's task.csv match deflections in ban's EEG at z = +7.19.
minhanh = ...005 was given by the operator. That session folder has never been in
this repo, so the mapping cannot be checked yet and the block order for that
recording is still unknown - the order is randomised per session and stored only
in the session's metadata.json. Copy the folder into behaviors/ and the pairing
will resolve by ID, or pass --order to label the blocks by hand.
